items.title: 7.3 Interference aur us ki types (qismein) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 7.3 with Fig. 7.5 and Examples 7.1 and 7.2 (PDF 143-146).

blocks.text: Ek jaisi frequency wali aur ek hi direction (simt) mein chalne wali do waves ki superposition se jo phenomenon (waqia) hota hai, use interference kehte hain.

blocks.alt: Do loudspeakers S1 aur S2 power amplifier P.A. se jure, jise oopar ek magenta dabba (audio generator, kitab ki tarah is par naam nahi) chalata hai. Neeche speakers ke parallel (mutawazi) ek thos aur ek dashed lakeer; thos par P1, P3, P5 aur dashed par P2, P4. S1 aur S2 se nuqton tak raaste. P1 par microphone CRO se jura hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 7.5(a): Sound waves ka interference dekhne ka experimental setup (intezam) (kitab ki Figure 7.5(a) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Speakers S1 aur S2, P.A. ke zariye A.G. se jure, gol wavefronts bhejte hain: S1 se magenta aur S2 se cyan qaus (arcs); thos qaus compressions aur dashed rarefactions. P1 se P5 tak nuqte speakers ke thora neeche, beech mein paas paas hain: P1, P3 aur P5 wahan jahan ek jaise qaus katte hain; P2 aur P4 wahan jahan thos qaus dashed se katta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 7.5 (b): Sound waves ka interference (kitab ki Figure 7.5 (b) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Do consecutive (saath wale) solid (ya dashed) arcs (golai wali lakeerein) ka faasla ek wavelength λ hai. P₁ par S₁ se 3½λ aur S₂ se 4½λ: farq λ, is liye sound (awaz) loud (oonchi) hoti hai (constructive). P₂ par S₁ se 3½λ aur S₂ se 4λ: farq ½λ, compression rarefaction se milta hai aur sound khatam (destructive). P₃ beech mein hai: farq zero.

Sound waves ka interference dekhne ka experimental set up Fig. 7.5(a) mein hai. Do loudspeakers S₁ aur S₂ ek Audio Generator (AG) se banne wali fixed (muqarrar) frequency ki harmonic sound waves ke do sources hain. Chunke dono speakers ek hi generator se chalte hain, is liye woh ek hi phase mein vibrate karte hain. Aise sources ko coherent sources kehte hain. Ek sensitive (hassas) Cathode Ray Oscilloscope (CRO) se juda microphone sound waves ka detector (pakarne wala) hai. CRO aane wale signal ko apni screen par waveform ki shakal mein dikhata hai. Microphone ko baari baari loudspeakers ke saamne different (alag alag) points par rakha jata hai, jaisa Fig. 7.5(b) mein hai.
